name: autobahn

args.name: handoff
args.description: Exact v1 registration ID or registered generation handoff path; required with goal-id unless goal is supplied.

args.name: goal-id
args.description: Explicit selected goal ID; repeat for a set. Required with handoff; incompatible with direct goal.

args.name: goal
args.description: Path to one nested direct-goal/1 envelope, instead of handoff and goal-id; no discovery fallback.

args.name: context
args.description: Independent readiness-context/1 input for exact subject, goals and stage; verify live authority separately before dispatch. Before ordinary or admin merges, require fresh merge-stage context for the original exact handoff/direct subject and selected goal; local-validation is supporting evidence, not merge admission.

args.name: engine
args.description: Override the per-goal engine (ultraqa|ultrawork|ralph|team) only after admission and live authority checks.

description: Admit exact v1 goals with independent policy context, then ship one ready goal per PR after live authority verification.
